title: Keep an Eye on Your Suitcase With a Discounted Apple AirTag
gist: A promotional deals post: Apple's second-generation AirTag is $23 on Amazon (21% off $29), matching the lowest tracked price, and a four-pack is $89. Minimal investor signal beyond routine Apple accessory discounting and Find My ecosystem use cases like luggage tracking.

insights.speaker: Louryn Strampe
insights.so_what: Recurring discounts on Apple accessories via Amazon indicate routine, not distressed, promotional pricing.
